content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Commissioner Goalpara District Technical Support Staff (DTSS) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: goalpara.assam.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Commissioner Goalpara DTSS recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the District Technical Support Staff (DTSS) posts is 05 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the DTSS post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 (Higher Secondary) and possess a Diploma in Information Technology (IT) from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any work experience required for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, at least one year of working experience in the IT field in a Government Institute or Government Project/Mission is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the District Technical Support Staff (DTSS) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 41 years, with a relaxation of up to 8 years for certain categories of applicants.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the DTSS position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 14,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline by post. Candidates should download the form from the official website and send it along with required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the District Commissioner Goalpara recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the DTSS role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Examination, Personal Interview, Computer Skill Test, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of District Commissioner Goalpara: goalpara.assam.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies for the DTSS post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the District Technical Support Staff (DTSS) position in this recruitment drive.
